    let hour_input be ask for a number ""
    let minute_input be ask for a number ""
    let advance_input be ask for a number ""
    let total_minutes be (((value of hour_input) * 60) + (value of minute_input) + (value of advance_input)) % 1440
    let resulting_hour be 0
    repeat 24 times:
        if total_minutes is at least 60:
            set total_minutes to total_minutes - 60
            set resulting_hour to resulting_hour + 1
    let resulting_minute be total_minutes
    let output_parts be an empty list of text
    add resulting_hour as text to output_parts
    add resulting_minute as text to output_parts
    say output_parts joined with " "
